name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the intricate workings of engines, fueled by his father's work as a mechanic. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in composite materials, and quickly found himself drawn to the high-stakes world of racing. He started his career in a smaller racing outfit, honing his skills in carbon fiber layup and repair, before catching the eye of Brasil Racing.

Arjun is known for his meticulous approach to his work, with an uncanny ability to spot even the most minute imperfections in composite structures. He believes that the key to success lies in understanding the material properties and applying them with precision. His dedication to perfectionism often leads him to work late hours, ensuring that every part is flawlessly crafted. He's eager to contribute to Brasil Racing's success and prove his mettle on the international stage.

What sets Arjun apart is his relentless pursuit of knowledge. He's constantly researching new composite materials and techniques, always striving to improve the performance and durability of the team's race cars. He also has a knack for quickly identifying and resolving composite failures, often saving valuable time and resources.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Arjun is of medium build, with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect composite parts.
Has a habit of muttering calculations under his breath while working.
